name: Thara Kornsuwan
source:
Likes: Kacha, cooking, customers

The kind and hospitable receptionist of Full Service Spa. Not much is known about this person.

The beautiful and petite receptionist at Full Service Spa. She inherited the building from her family, and works hard everyday to keep the spa afloat. Behind that smile, is someone who works hard and loves her family. But even someone like her, who remains happy and bubbly to the customers of the spa, has secrets to hide.
